children.game_version: Hand-switch game practicing switching between open-handed and cross-handed holds in rhythm.

seniors.seated_version: Execute alternating step-touches while seated, practicing open-handed and cross-handed arm positions at waist height.
seniors.standing_version: Perform stationary alternating foot steps with supported hand connections and reduced turn velocity.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo, stationary or small step range.

learning_units.description: Executing open-handed and cross-handed partner grips at waist height.
Applying subtle leg weighting (lead right leg / follower left leg) to facilitate smooth step turns.

social_formats.description: Partner dance with lead and follower in face-to-face open or cross-handed holds.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Open-handed position (right hand to left, left to right below waist) or cross-handed position (right hands crossed on top, left hands below).
movement_profile.footwork: Alternating feet stepping or walking in time to the music; subtle weighting down of lead right leg / follower left leg to free the opposite leg.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couples dancing face-to-face with underarm turns and open/cross hand transitions.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to ground, no jumps described in sources.
movement_profile.partnering: Lead and follower connect via open-handed or cross-handed holds.
movement_profile.posture: Partners face each other with hands connected slightly below waist level.

signature_moves.description: Alternating foot stepping resembling stepping on and off a curb, caused by exaggerated leg weighting.
signature_moves.name: Hobble Step

signature_moves.description: Underarm turn executed from a crossed-hand connection with right hands joined on top.
signature_moves.name: Cross-Handed Turn

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid overly rigid arm tension or forcing turns without proper leg weight shifts.

basic_steps: Open-handed or cross-handed hold below waist level
Alternating stepping in time with the music
Weighting down lead right leg / follower left leg
Freeing opposite leg for underarm turns and swings
teaching.formation: Partnering face-to-face in open-handed or cross-handed positions.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners often display an exaggerated hobble step; instruction focuses on refining weight placement.
teaching.rhythm: Six-count meter adaptation or continuous alternating stepping in time to the music.
